seo.title: CueBooker | Tell it. Don't lose the booking.
seo.description: Turn calls, WhatsApps, emails and conversations into bookings you can actually follow. Speak or type, review what CueBooker understood, and keep context, status and dates under control.

hero.eyebrow: REAL BOOKINGS. LESS MEMORY. MORE CONTROL.
hero.body: WhatsApp, call, email or voice. Cuebooker understands what matters, shows it to you and keeps the thread intact until the date is resolved.

problem.eyebrow: BOOKINGS DO NOT START IN A FORM
problem.title: There are enough tools. The problem is scattered conversations.
problem.body: A booking may start on WhatsApp, change by phone and finish by email. The trouble starts days later when you need to remember who said what, whether you were waiting for a reply, which fee was discussed or whether the date was still free.
problem.statement: CueBooker does not force you into another channel. It turns what already happens into an operational thread that stays intact.

search.eyebrow: LATER · WHEN A REAL NETWORK EXISTS
search.title: Trajectory first. Discovery later.
search.body: Once real bookings, relationships and availability exist, CueBooker can add artist discovery without turning followers or popularity into a measure of value. The core remains the artist's real work and trajectory.
search.resultHint: Concept view of a future feature. Budget filters matches, but each DJ's fee remains private. Artists and results are fictional.

flow.eyebrow: FROM A CONVERSATION TO A TRACKABLE BOOKING
flow.title: Talk as you normally do. CueBooker handles the admin.
flow.body: Capture what just happened, review what CueBooker understood and continue from a live booking. Status, conversation, next action and calendar stay connected.

steps.name: 1. Tell it
steps.detail: Speak or type naturally. You do not need to complete a perfect form.

steps.name: 2. Review
steps.detail: CueBooker proposes contact, venue or promoter, date, fee, conditions and anything still missing.

steps.name: 3. Follow the thread
steps.detail: Messages, calls and notes stay attached to the same booking and operational status follows the conversation.

steps.name: 4. Decide
steps.detail: Confirm, reject or cancel when the time comes. Consequential decisions remain yours.

steps.name: 5. Protect the date
steps.detail: Provisionally reserve a date when needed and let the calendar reflect what is actually confirmed.

integrations.eyebrow: DO NOT CHANGE HOW YOU WORK
integrations.title: The booking can start anywhere. The follow-up ends up in CueBooker.
integrations.body: Phone, WhatsApp, email, Instagram, an in-person conversation or a public form. CueBooker centralises context without forcing the promoter into another platform.

items.label: SMART CAPTURE
items.name: Voice or text
items.body: Describe what happened. CueBooker structures the information, flags uncertainty and lets you review before creating the booking.

items.label: CONVERSATION
items.name: One thread
items.body: Every interaction stays in the same context. You know what was said, what is missing and who is waiting on whom.

items.label: CALENDAR
items.name: Dates with context
items.body: A provisional date does not look confirmed, and a confirmed date does not live separately from the booking that created it.

integrations.note: CueBooker is not trying to replace WhatsApp, email or phone. Its job is to stop opportunities depending on your memory.

roles.eyebrow: LOW VOLUME OR HIGH, THE PROBLEM IS THE SAME
roles.title: Value from the first booking. More depth as the work grows.

items.name: Independent DJ
items.headline: Two gigs a month still deserve not to get lost.
items.body: When someone calls about a date, save it in seconds. CueBooker remembers who it was, what was discussed, what is missing and where it fits in your calendar.

items.name: Promoter or venue
items.headline: You do not need to learn another tool to talk to a DJ.
items.body: Keep using phone, email or the channels you already use. When you use the public form, the information enters the artist's same operational system already structured.

items.name: Manager or agency
items.headline: The same thread across your whole roster.
items.body: Each artist keeps bookings, holds and calendar context separated inside the workspace, with shared team access and permissions when needed.

access.eyebrow: THE WORKSPACE BELONGS TO THE ARTIST AND THEIR TEAM
access.title: Start simple. Structure appears when you need it.
access.body: A DJ can work alone inside one workspace. An agency uses the same core across several artists. A promoter does not have to adopt CueBooker for the DJ to keep proper follow-up.
access.demoNote: DJs and agencies can now create an account and enter the real Booking Core workspace.

entry.eyebrow: TRY IT ON A REAL BOOKING
entry.title: Next time someone asks about a date, do not leave it in your head.
entry.body: Open + CUE, tell CueBooker what happened and review how it turns that conversation into a booking you can follow.

feedback.title: We want to test it against the way you actually work.
feedback.body: If you are a DJ, manager, agency, promoter or venue, tell us how bookings reach you and what tends to get lost between one conversation and the next.
feedback.note: This form is for product testing and feedback. To use your private workspace, create an account.

form.title: Take part in CueBooker testing
form.body: Tell us about your role. We will contact you to test features and collect feedback on your real workflow.
form.emailHelp: We will use your email to contact you about CueBooker testing.
form.consentText: I agree that CueBooker may use my details to contact me about testing and send project-related updates.
form.success: We have received your details. We will contact you about upcoming tests and feedback sessions.
form.invalid: The information is not valid. Check your email address and try again.

join.title: Try it on the next booking you receive.
join.body: CueBooker matters when it enters a real situation: a call, an offer, a pending reply or a date you need to protect. Create your workspace and see whether it helps you remember less and follow up better.

distribution.title: Put your link where you need it. Context returns to the same place.
distribution.body: Share the profile, open the booking form directly, generate attributed links or embed it on a website. However the enquiry arrives, it lands in the same Booking Core.

channels.label: LINK
channels.name: Profile and booking
channels.body: Share your own URL from Instagram, bio, WhatsApp, email or EPK.

channels.label: WIDGET
channels.name: On your website
channels.body: Embed the CueBooker-hosted form without duplicating backend or booking logic.

channels.label: QR / SOURCE
channels.name: Know where it came from
channels.body: Use QR and attributed links to distinguish web, Instagram, WhatsApp, email or campaigns.

distribution.note: The promoter does not need an account. The artist keeps one conversation, one booking and one history.

identity.title: Your public identity connected to real work.
identity.body: Artist Profile brings presentation, booking and professional context together. Photo and artwork remain valid. CUE ID is an optional layer, not a requirement or a replacement for trajectory.
